title: Optimal Correction Sets for Provable Redress of Contestable Causal Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.33138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constraint-based causal discovery relies on conditional-independence (CI) tests that may conflict in finite samples, leaving no causal graph that satisfies them all. Causal Assumption-based Argumentation (ABA) makes these tests explicit as defeasible commitments, and offers correspondence guarantees with a subset of them, but its existing repair procedure releases facts heuristically and offers no formal response to a user's contestation of a release. We argue that contestable causal discovery requires an inspectable repair object, a justification for it, and a predictable revision procedure for such contestations. We therefore formulate CI-fact repair as a minimum-cost correction problem and implement it in Answer Set Programming (ASP). translated_title: 面向可争议因果发现的可证明补救的最优修正集
translated_abstract: 基于约束的因果发现依赖于条件独立性（CI）测试，而这些测试在有限样本中可能相互冲突，导致不存在能够同时满足所有测试的因果图。因果假设论证（Causal Assumption-based Argumentation, ABA）将这些测试显式地表示为可反驳的承诺，并提供了与其子集之间的对应性保证，但其现有的修复程序以启发式方式释放事实，且未对用户针对事实释放提出的质疑提供正式回应。我们认为，可争议的因果发现需要一个可审查的修复对象、针对该对象的论证说明，以及应对此类质疑的可预测修订程序。为此，我们将CI事实修复形式化为一个最小成本修正问题，并在答案集编程（ASP）中加以实现。在因果ABA的基础上，我们提供了因果一致性的紧凑且高效的ASP编码，具有可靠性与完备性保证，并在最优稳定模型之间建立了双向投影对应关系。
tldr: 该论文将相互冲突的条件独立性测试的修复形式化为最小成本修正问题，并用答案集编程（ASP）高效求解，为可争议的因果发现提供了具有可靠性与完备性保证的最优修正集及其可审查的论证机制。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the repair of conflicting conditional-independence tests as a minimum-cost correction problem solved efficiently with Answer Set Programming, providing provably sound and complete optimal correction sets with inspectable justifications for contestable causal discovery.
